Three directions

Bringing more of Sarawak into the PSL site

Same brand, same content — three different ways to bring a distinctly Sarawakian identity into the design. Each mockup below is built with real photography (Wikimedia Commons, credited) and real PSL copy so you can judge it at scale. Scroll to compare, then tell me which direction to build out across the full site — or mix pieces from each.

A

Bumi Kenyalang

Keeps today's black/red PSL identity front and centre, adds the hornbill emblem and flag-gold as a refined accent. Confident and editorial — the safest evolution.

B

Sungai & Hutan

Forest green joins the palette; Bako's cliffs and river motifs ground PSL in Sarawak's land, echoing "Lestari" (sustainable). Warmer, more organic.

C

Tenun & Ukiran

The boldest option — Iban weaving and longhouse carving patterns become structural design elements. Most distinctive, most "unmistakably Sarawak."

A · Bumi Kenyalang
